text:
zoe (PM): quick huddle 1 - customers seeing dup charges when bursts cross regions. need an idempotent loan flow + reconciliation. propose backend ledger first, UI later. agree?
ash (Eng): idempotency is must. POST /tenants/:id/loan with idempotency_key. ledger entries: loaned|consumed|reconciled.
lee (Infra): cross-region writes flaky. we'll write loans to local region, emit tombstones, and run a reconciler to merge. eventual consistency OK but ledger must be monotonic.
cam (SRE): define alerts: unreconciled_loans > 0.2% sustained -> page. reconciliation latency > 10m -> warn. Must also ensure no double-consume.
viv (Platform): API shape fine. console: phase1 backend-only + admin API; phase2 show table + CSV export.
ida (Customer Success): customers want audit logs for billing. include loan_id, source_pool, target_region, timestamp in API. CSV sample would help pilots.
zoe (PM): rollout plan: alpha internal -> 2 pilot customers -> GA. launch criteria: idempotent API + reconciler + invariants + pilot no billing mismatches.
ash (Eng): tech tasks: idempotent API, loan TTL, reconciliation worker, migration backfill, metrics + tests. estimate 3 sprints minimal.
lee (Infra): we should add logical epoch per tenant to handle reordering. reconcilers run every 5m, compaction pass every 6h.
cam (SRE): runbook: if ledger invariant breach, pause loan issuance for affected tenants and route to primary. assign SRE buddy during pilot first 48h.
viv (Platform): billing impact: use single ledger approach (owner pool decrements). we'll track loan metadata for chargebacks. console UI later.
ida (Customer Success): will recruit 2 pilot customers who reported issues; will prepare messaging that clarifies a 6h reconciliation window.
billing-bot: billing reconcile job scheduled: ledger-reconciler -> staging at 2026-04-06T04:00Z
zoe (PM): owners: ash -> API + backfill, lee -> reconcilers + epochs, viv -> admin API + console hooks, cam -> SLOs/runbook, ida -> pilot comms.
ash (Eng): will open RFC 1797770000-ledger-opsync.md by EOD.
zoe (PM): decision: backend-first confirmed. UI and auto-forgive policies deferred to phase2. reconvene Thurs for RFC review. :thumbsup:
